title: Staff UI Engineer
description:
**About SailPoint:**
SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the self-hosted and cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of enterprise companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less.
  
  
Built on a foundation of customer-customization and extensibility, our Identity Product Platform delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time—matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s self-hosted and cloud-oriented, modern enterprise.
  
  
**About the Role:**
SailPoint is seeking UI Engineers to join our engineering team and shape the front-end user experience of our cloud-based SaaS product, Identity Now.
  
  
**The Mission:**
Your core objective in this role is to architect and deliver high-performance, intuitive UI experiences using the Angular framework, while simultaneously elevating frontend code quality, testing standards, and the overall velocity of our engineering team. You will operate in a highly Agile environment, building new functionalities and evolving our publicly available legacy components.
  
  
**What You Bring (Requirements):**

* 10+ years of professional software development experience creating fast, scalable, and cross-browser compatible web-based UIs.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, REST, AJAX, XML, and HTTP.
* Production experience with one or more major JavaScript frameworks and tooling (Angular highly preferred; React, ExtJS, Webpack, NodeJS also valued).
* Proven experience with Automated UI testing frameworks (e.g., Cypress, Jest, Karma, Protractor, Selenium, Jasmine).
* A solid understanding of backend architecture and microservices systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* A Degree in Computer Science or equivalent preferred (or relevant hands-on work experience).

**Bonus Points If You Have:**

* Advanced experience with the modern Angular ecosystem (Angular, TypeScript, NgRx, NodeJS, and NestJS).
* Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) deployments.
* Previous experience building commercial security applications or enterprise infrastructure products.
* Deep experience in an Agile/Scrum development methodology.

**What You Will Achieve (Your Milestones):**
Instead of a generic list of responsibilities, here is what success looks like in your first year:
  
  
**Within 30 Days:**

* Map our current UI architecture, take ownership of incident response workflows, and resolve initial customer UI bugs. You will dive into application telemetry to identify immediate UI pain points and propose targeted improvements.

**Within 60 Days:**

* Ship major responsive Angular/TypeScript components to production. You will closely collaborate with our UX team on interaction designs and partner with Microservices teams to define strict, scalable REST API contracts.

**Within 90 Days:**

* Own software quality from the front end. You will significantly increase automated UI test coverage (using frameworks like Cypress, Jest, or Karma) on your assigned Identity Now modules, ensuring zero critical UI regressions on your releases.

**Within 6 Months & Beyond:**

* Serve as a technical mentor to mid-level and junior engineers. You will work directly with Product Management to break down engineering work, create accurate estimates for quarterly epics, and lead frontend architecture planning sessions.

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**
Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity,
  
  
Innovation, Impact, and Individuals.
  
  
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model, enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.
* Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents
* Annual performance bonus
* Private equity at certain levels
* 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays
* Flexible Work hours.

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Lead UI Engineer / Sr Staff UI Engineer (ROR (Nice to have), Ember JS (Nice to have) / Java Script (Must) / Type Script , React , Angular)
description:
**Sr Staff UI Engineer**
**What You Will Do**
Open Blue AI Platform group is playing a key part in realizing the promise of our digital transformation initiative – Open Blue. This group focuses on technologies like edge computing, ML Model Edification and running ML Model at the edge with constrained resources in the most optimized way.
  
  
Sr Staff UI Engineer position will focus on design and development of new features/components as well as maintenance and stewardship of Open Blue AI Platform. This position requires the ability to work under guidance with a team of engineers to design and develop robust system solutions that meet defined system requirements.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Good verbal and written communication in English Language with an ability to express and understand complex technical concepts
* Develop software according to functional and technical design specifications.
* Participate in design and code reviews/inspections.
* Provide input to technical discussions; propose solutions and alternatives. Interact with other Sr members of the team to ensure that solution fits with overall architecture.
* Analyzing, troubleshooting, and providing code fixes for reported problems and change requests.
* Writing and executing unit tests.
* Developing proof-of-concept prototypes; Providing work estimates
* Aid testers and support personnel as needed to determine system problems
* Should have can do attitude and initiative to start and complete the assigned activities.
* Job Location: Pune

**Information Security Responsibilities**

* Adhere to JCI policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets.
* Adhere to JCI product security standards and guidelines for secured software product development.
* The software, licenses, shall be deployed and used only in accordance with JCI licensing agreements.
* Unless provided in the applicable license, notice, or agreement, copyrighted software shall not be duplicated, except for backup and archival purposes.
* Any software that is acquired illegally or does not have a valid license shall not be deployed or used. Copying of third party materials without an appropriate license is prohibited.
* The employees, contractors or third-party personnel shall not copy, extract or reproduce in any way, copyrighted material from the Internet on information systems provided by organization, other than permitted by copyright law.
* Implement appropriate physical and technical safeguards to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information assets.
* All employees, contractors and third parties shall be responsible to report all information security incidents, alerts, warnings and suspected vulnerabilities, in a timely manner, and share such information only with authorized personnel.

What we look for
  
  
**Required**

* Qualification — B.Tech. or M.Tech. in Computer Science
* Must have 6–8 years of experience in web application development using HTML, CSS/Sass and JavaScript (ES2022+)
* Must be able to perform in an individual contributor role and must be willing to step up in the role of hands-on technical lead as required
* Experienced with core concepts of JavaScript and JavaScript design patterns
* Experience with a component-based SPA framework at scale — Ember.js strongly preferred; equivalent depth in React or Angular acceptable, with willingness to work in Ember day to day
* Experience integrating a JavaScript SPA with a server-rendered backend
* Experience with front-end build and tooling: ember-cli / Broccoli, Webpack, Babel, Sass, Node.js v20, pnpm
* Experience with unit, integration and browser-based testing: QUnit, qunit-dom, @ember/test-helpers, Testem, headless Chrome; equivalent experience with Jest, Karma, Jasmine considered
* Experience building data-dense operational UIs
* Experience of working with PostgreSQL and Redis, including RedisTimeSeries; exposure to MongoDB or other document stores is a plus
* Experience and knowledge of Git / GitHub, JIRA and Scrum methodology
* Experience of working with globally distributed teams

Strongly preferred
  
  

* Working experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails in production
* Working knowledge of networking and security fundamentals
* Experience with client-side internationalization
* Experience maintaining a shared internal component library consumed by multiple applications
* Experience with dependency and CVE remediation in a JS dependency tree
* Experience with a good understanding of UX design patterns.

Why Join Us
  
  
At Johnson Controls, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a global business focused on safety, sustainability, and customer value. You will work with collaborative teams, solve complex UI challenges, and help shape frontend practices that support long-term product quality and growth.
  
  
If you are ready to lead modern UI engineering work in Pune, we would love to hear from you.

title: SAP ABAB/Fiori
description:
Job Description

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced SAP developer who can build both classic ABAP solutions and modern cloud applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). You will work across S/4HANA extensions, custom applications, and user-facing Fiori apps, and help bridge on-premise ABAP and cloud-native development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain ABAP solutions, including reports, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits, DDIC objects, ALV outputs, and forms.
* Build and expose OData services using CAP (Node.js or Java) with CDS data models, service handlers, and business logic.
* Develop responsive SAP Fiori applications using Fiori Elements and SAPUI5 freestyle, including annotations, extensions, and Fiori Launchpad configuration.
* Integrate CAP services with S/4HANA and other SAP or non-SAP systems through OData, SOAP, REST, and APIs.
* Implement authorization, role-based access, and secure service design in CAP and ABAP.
* Deploy and operate applications on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry), including use of HANA Cloud, destinations, and service bindings.
* Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, code reviews, unit testing, and deployment support.
* Document technical designs, interfaces, and solutions for both internal teams and customers.

**Required Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on ABAP development experience, including ABAP OO, reports, enhancements, and performance tuning.
* Practical experience with OData services, either ABAP Gateway/RAP or CAP.
* Strong hands-on experience with CAP: CDS modeling, service definitions, handlers, and deployment.
* Solid experience with SAP Fiori/SAPUI5, Fiori Elements, and annotation-driven UI development.
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP, Cloud Foundry, and SAP HANA (SQL, CDS views).
* Good understanding of web technologies: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript (preferred), HTML, CSS, and REST/JSON.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work with functional consultants and business users.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with ABAP RAP (RESTful Application Programming model) and/or Cloud ABAP.
* Exposure to SAP Business Application Studio or VS Code with SAP extensions.
* Experience with SAP Integration Suite (CPI), Event Mesh, or SAP AI Core.
* Knowledge of S/4HANA Cloud extensibility or side-by-side extensions.
* SAP certifications in ABAP, CAP, BTP, or Fiori.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: Web Manager
description:
**Contract role: 11 months**

**About Us**

CBIZ is a leading professional services company providing accounting, tax, advisory, benefits, insurance, and technology solutions to middle-market organizations across the United States. We help clients navigate complexity, manage risk, and pursue growth through practical insight and disciplined execution.

With more than 9,500 team members across 23 major markets, CBIZ brings deep expertise and local understanding to every engagement, supported by integrated teams across the globe.

**Our Services**

CBIZ delivers a comprehensive range of professional services designed to help organizations grow, manage risk, and navigate complexity.

**Our Service Areas:**

* Accounting
* Tax
* Advisory
* Benefits & HR
* Insurance
* Technology

**Our Mission**

To provide exceptional advice and solutions that help our clients achieve their goals.

**Our Vision**

To be recognized by our clients as the premier provider of accounting, insurance, and other professional business services and by our team members as their employer of choice.

**Join Us on Our Journey**

As we continue to grow and expand our horizons, CBIZ remains committed to delivering exceptional service and value to our clients. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and explore the possibilities that we offer.

**Role Overview**

The Web Manager is responsible for the performance, health, and growth of the company website as a core marketing channel. The role leads search visibility across traditional search (SEO) and AI-driven discovery (AEO/GEO), ensuring the brand is found on Google and cited in AI-generated answers.

The position combines technical ownership with marketing impact, covering site maintenance, optimization, page development, analytics, governance, agency partnerships, and digital investments while connecting web performance to leads, pipeline, and business growth.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Build, edit, and publish pages, landing pages, and templates in the CMS using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Own the SEO, AEO, and GEO roadmap across technical, on-page, and content
* Run technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, sitemaps, canonicals, and internal linking
* Implement structured data (JSON-LD) and entity-led content so the brand is cited in AI-generated answers
* Track rankings, organic traffic, and AI visibility, and report on competitor benchmarks
* Manage day-to-day site health: uptime, security, backups, plugins, and updates
* Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS)
* Run CRO programs including A/B tests, UX fixes, and form and CTA optimization
* Set up and manage GA4, GTM, Search Console, and heatmap tools with accurate event and conversion tracking
* Build dashboards and deliver regular reports that link web performance to leads and pipeline
* Manage external web, SEO, analytics, and digital agency partners to deliver projects on time, within budget, and aligned to business and website performance goals
* Manage website budgets, agency retainers, software subscriptions, and project investments to maximize efficiency and business impact
* Establish and maintain website governance, including content standards, accessibility requirements, SEO best practices, and publishing workflows

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8-10 years in website management, SEO, or digital marketing
* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field
* Hands-on expertise with a WordPress
* Strong technical SEO skills with Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Search Console
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, schema markup, and page speed tools
* Proficiency in GA4 and GTM, with the ability to present data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* B2B, SaaS, or professional services experience
* Familiarity with Power BI for data analysis
* Experience with website migrations, multilingual SEO, or headless CMS setups

title: Supervisor, Software Engineering (IN)
description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
Job Description SummaryJob Description: Technical Lead / Supervisor, Software Engineering
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Technical Lead / Supervisor, Software Engineering with a strong full-stack background to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of our client engagements, acting as a crucial bridge between business requirements and technical execution. You will not only drive technical architecture and design but also remain a hands-on individual contributor, mentoring a team of engineers while leveraging modern AI tools, cloud infrastructure, and observability practices to deliver high-quality software. cription Summary
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions, gather and refine technical requirements, and translate them into actionable engineering tasks.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams working on the same product, as well as with other external or dependent teams on a need basis, to ensure seamless integration, alignment, and delivery.
* Architecture & Design: Spearhead technical design and architectural decisions for new and existing projects whenever necessary.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Performance: Monitor cloud application performance, deeply understand deployed cloud components, and actively collaborate with the infrastructure team to suggest and implement architectural improvements.
* Team Mentorship: Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support to the engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and positive problem-solving.
* Hands-On Development: Act as a strong individual contributor (IC) working on user story implementation, primarily focusing on Node.js and GraphQL backends.
* Modern Engineering Practices: Champion Spec Driven Development (SDD) and efficiently leverage AI concepts and tools (e.g., LLMs, code assistants) to accelerate development workflows.
* System Reliability: Implement and monitor robust telemetry-based observability to ensure system health, performance, and reliability.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 10+ years of proven experience in the IT industry, with an extensive background in Tech Lead or similar leadership roles.
* Primary Tech Stack: Deep, hands-on expertise in backend development using Node.js, GraphQL, and REST APIs.
* Database Expertise: Strong hands-on proficiency with PostgreSQL, including database schema design, complex query writing, indexing, and query optimization.
* Secondary Tech Stack: Solid working knowledge of frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, and TypeScript.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with major cloud providers, specifically AWS and/or Azure, with a strong understanding of core cloud services and deployment models.
* DevOps & Infrastructure: Proven hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, specifically Docker Swarm and Kubernetes.
* Data & Caching: Strong experience working with in-memory data stores and caches, particularly Redis.
* AI Integration: Familiarity with AI concepts and the practical ability to use AI tools effectively to assist in daily coding and architectural tasks.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills, ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams, and a proactive, positive attitude toward tackling complex technical challenges.

**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.
  
  
**Job Posting Statement**
To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
  
  
**AI Technology Statement**
Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.
  
  
**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.
  
  
**How We Work**

* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.
  
  
Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You’ll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
* Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
* Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects
* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member II - Guidewire and React Developer
description:
**Job Summary**
This position works with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, UX designers, and Agile team members to develop, test, and deploy Guidewire PolicyCenter solutions and React-based digital applications. React development is a mandatory capability for this role. The developer uses foundational to intermediate Guidewire configuration and integration skills together with hands-on React, JavaScript or TypeScript, responsive user interface, REST API integration, and automated testing experience. Experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform is a plus. The role follows established coding, design, accessibility, security, and delivery standards and delivers reliable working functionality each sprint with support and guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Develops and modifies Guidewire PolicyCenter components and React-based web applications to deliver approved business and digital experience requirements
* Interprets customer, business, and user experience needs and provides technical input into feasible application solutions and system design
* Builds reusable React components, screens, forms, and workflows using modern JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or SCSS, and approved component libraries
* Integrates React applications with Guidewire and enterprise services using REST APIs, JSON payloads, and established authentication and authorization patterns
* Codes and configures Guidewire programs, objects, components, and packaged software using established standards and conventions
* Documents implementation details and performs quality checks on Guidewire configuration, React code, API integrations, test evidence, and supporting documentation
* Delivers working functionality incrementally each sprint and modifies existing code or configuration to meet approved requirements
* Performs detailed impact assessments across business processes, data, Guidewire applications, APIs, digital channels, and integrations; identifies and raises functional or technical risks
* Creates unit and component tests and applies Test-Driven Development or Behavior-Driven Development practices where appropriate
* Supports application implementation, release, environment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions across Guidewire and React components with guidance
* Takes ownership of assigned deliverables, communicates status and impediments, and completes issue resolution in a timely manner

**Requirements**
**Guidewire Technical Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in software development, solution engineering, or a related technology field
* Hands-on experience developing web applications using React and modern JavaScript; TypeScript experience is preferred
* Working knowledge of React functional components, hooks, props, component composition, state management, routing, reusable design patterns, and front-end error handling
* Experience with HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, SCSS or CSS modules, browser developer tools, and cross-browser compatibility
* Experience consuming REST APIs, handling asynchronous operations, processing JSON payloads, and displaying service data in React applications
* Experience writing front-end unit and component tests using tools such as Jest and React Testing Library
* Working knowledge of Node.js, npm, package management, dependency management, build tooling, linting, code formatting, and front-end CI/CD practices
* Ability to apply accessibility, basic internationalization, performance, security, and responsive design practices to customer- and producer-facing applications
* Ability to translate approved UX designs or design-system specifications into reusable and accessible React components
* Experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform or Jutro-based React applications is a plus

**Agile Delivery and Collaboration**

* Partners with the Product Owner, UX designers, and team members to confirm that implementation and acceptance tests reflect the intended functionality and user experience
* Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities
* Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and owns assigned work items
* Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps
* Demonstrates integrated PolicyCenter and React functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos
* Actively develops T-shaped Guidewire and React skills, participates in Communities of Practice, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement
* Works effectively across development, testing, product, UX, architecture, and business partners to improve flow and transparency

**Additional Qualifications**

* Strong verbal communication, listening, writing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to adjust technical detail for the audience
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including breaking down moderately complex issues, identifying root cause, comparing alternatives, and recommending a viable solution
* Ability to use data to identify meaningful information, patterns, or conclusions and organize the steps needed to address an issue
* Strong ownership and accountability for individual deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple assignments
* Foundational knowledge of object-oriented and component-based programming, defensive coding, error handling, version control, databases, SQL, and integrated development environments
* Working-level understanding of applications within the assigned domain and the flow of data between Guidewire, digital applications, and internal or external systems
* Broad understanding of insurance concepts, terminology, products, and business processes
* Ability to share knowledge, provide constructive feedback, and support others in areas of developing expertise

title: CMS & Ecommerce Platform Lead
description:
**CMS & Ecommerce Platform Lead (Wordpress, Shopify, Sanity, Webflow)**
Location: Pune, India
  
  
Type: Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a CMS & Ecommerce Lead to own our website content platform and online storefront end-to-end. You'll manage everything from site architecture and content operations to product merchandising, checkout experience, and conversion optimization. This is a hybrid technical/operational role for someone who's equally comfortable managing/developing a CMS content model and analyzing funnel drop-off on the product listing page.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
CMS & Content Operations
  
  

* Own the CMS platform — traditional or headless (e.g., Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, Magento) including architecture, templates, and content governance
* Evaluate and drive decisions around headless/composable CMS architecture where it improves flexibility, omnichannel delivery, or front-end performance
* Manage the site's information architecture, ensuring content is structured for scalability, SEO, and reusability across pages/components
* Manage integrations between the CMS and other tools (analytics, personalization, marketing automation, CRM)
* Evaluate and recommend CMS platform upgrades, migrations, or replacements as the organization scales
* Troubleshoot CMS bugs and liaise with engineering/dev teams on more complex technical issues
* Ensure the website meets accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA), auditing templates, components, and content for issues like alt text, color contrast, keyboard navigation, and semantic markup
* Manage content modeling and API-driven content delivery for headless implementations, partnering closely with front-end engineering on consumption of the content API
* Define and maintain information architecture, taxonomy, and metadata standards across the site, structured for reuse across web, app, and other channels
* Manage the publishing workflow and QA process for landing pages, campaigns, and product content
* Manage site publishing, domain, DNS, and SSL/hosting configuration, ensuring the site is live, secure, and correctly pointed across environments
* Monitor site performance, page speed, and technical SEO health related to CMS configuration
* Train internal teams on CMS usage and maintain documentation/best practices

Ecommerce & Storefront Management
  
  

* Own the online storefront experience — product listing pages, collection pages, checkout flow, and merchandising
* Manage product catalog setup, categorization, pricing rules, and inventory sync with backend systems (ERP/OMS)
* Own site merchandising calendar — homepage takeovers, collections, promotions, and seasonal campaigns
* Monitor site performance, page speed, and mobile experience, partnering with engineering on fixes
* Manage integrations between the storefront and third-party tools (payments, reviews, personalization, email/SMS, analytics)

Cross-functional
  
  

* Partner with design and engineering on new page templates, storefront features, and platform upgrades
* Collaborate with marketing on landing page builds for campaigns and promotions

**What We're Looking For**

* 6+ years managing a CMS and/or ecommerce platform, including experience with both traditional and headless/composable systems (e.g., Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, Shopify Plus, Magento, BigCommerce, Wordpress, WooCommerce)
* Understanding of headless/composable architecture and API-driven content delivery (REST/GraphQL), and when it's the right fit vs. a traditional monolithic CMS
* Hands-on experience with product catalog management, merchandising, and promotions setup
* Hands-on experience with templates, architecture, taxonomy, and metadata standards across the site
* Hands-on experience in JavaScript/Liquid, php language (or platform-equivalent templating language)
* Solid understanding of HTML/CSS; comfortable with light template/theme edits
* Experience running or analyzing A/B tests and CRO experiments
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable in GA4/analytics tools, hubspot, interpreting funnel and conversion data
* Working knowledge of hosting, publishing website, domain management, DNS configuration, and SSL/certificate setup and renewal
* Working knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2) and experience auditing or remediating sites for compliance
* Detail-oriented with a strong QA mindset, especially around checkout and payment flows
* Project management skills to juggle multiple stakeholders (marketing, design, engineering, ops)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with a CMS-to-ecommerce migration or replatform to a headless/composable stack
* Familiarity with headless cms and decoupling front-end from back-end logic
* Experience with international/multi-currency or multi-language storefronts
* Familiarity with personalization or recommendation engines
* Custom plugins, widgets development

**Job Description**
Position Purpose/Objective (in broad terms describe what the job does and the expected end results)
  
  
Global IT is on a strategic journey to modernize Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities, delivering secure, scalable and user-friendly SharePoint Online services across all global sites.
  
  
The Technical Consultant – SharePoint Online sits within the IT – Core Business Solutions team and serves as the primary technical authority for SharePoint Online, modern SharePoint architecture and the SharePoint Framework (SPFx). This role is responsible for designing, developing, migrating and optimizing SharePoint Online solutions, including the modernization and migration of classic SharePoint sites to the SharePoint Online modern experience.
  
  
Reporting to the ITDP/Solution Architect, this role combines deep Microsoft 365 engineering expertise with automation and integration skills across Power Automate, PowerShell and Azure cloud services. The consultant leads technical delivery, guides best-practice adoption, supports governance and compliance, and ensures the platform remains secure, maintainable and future-ready in alignment with digital transformation roadmap.
  
  
MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES (list KEY activities, expected results and the ways results are measured)
  
  

* Take ownership of the functional and technical solutions in the designated Microsoft 365 / SharePoint domain.
* Review and manage changes and daily operations delivered by external partners, ensuring quality, maintainability and adherence to standards.
* Translate business requirements into clear SharePoint Online functional and technical designs, including information architecture, security model, automation and integration patterns.

Technical Ownership & Governance
  
  

* Act as the primary technical SME for SharePoint Online, modern sites, communication sites, team sites, hub sites, lists, libraries, content types and metadata models.
* Define and maintain SharePoint Online governance covering site lifecycle, ownership, permissions, external sharing, naming standards, information protection, retention and operational support handover.
* Establish best-practice design principles for SharePoint Online solutions, covering usability, accessibility, searchability, performance, security, maintainability and supportability.
* Provide technical guidance to business stakeholders, IT Business Partners, Solution Architects, AMS teams and external delivery partners.

Design, Build, Migration & Automation
  
  

* Design, develop and support modern SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions using the latest supported SPFx patterns, including web parts, extensions and reusable components aligned to development standards.
* Lead the migration and modernization of classic SharePoint sites to SharePoint Online, including assessment, remediation, migration planning, modern site design, validation and post-migration stabilization.
* Develop and maintain Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, notifications, document lifecycle automation and business process orchestration, replacing legacy workflows where applicable.
* Use PowerShell and PnP PowerShell for SharePoint Online administration, provisioning, permissions reporting, bulk updates, migration support and operational automation.
* Design and implement integrations with Microsoft platform services including Azure cloud services, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Teams and other enterprise applications where required.
* Define reusable templates, provisioning patterns, runbooks and technical standards for secure and scalable SharePoint Online delivery.
* Participate in solution reviews, change reviews, testing, deployment and hypercare for SharePoint Online enhancements and migration releases.
* Respond to security, compliance and audit observations by remediating configuration gaps and providing evidence for implemented controls.

Delivery & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to refine requirements and convert them into practical Microsoft 365 / SharePoint Online solutions.
* Coordinate with AMS vendors and third-party partners to ensure operational continuity, release coordination, incident/problem resolution and knowledge transfer.
* Support escalations and complex issue resolution related to SharePoint Online, Power Automate, PowerShell automation, Azure integrations and migration defects.

Team & Capability
  
  

* Ensure proper documentation, configuration records, solution design documents and runbooks are maintained for the SharePoint Online platform.
* Promote best practices, knowledge sharing, reuse of standard components and continuous improvement across Microsoft 365 collaboration services.

**Job Title: Senior Front End Developer**

**Location: Hinjewadi Phase 1 - Pune**

**Shift Time: EMEA**

***Role Description :***

**About the Role**

As a Frontend Engineer specializing in React.js at Capco, you will be at the heart of designing and developing modern, high-performance, and accessible user interfaces for high-value digital solutions in the banking and insurance sectors. You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver robust, high-quality, and scalable applications.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and developing responsive and performant user interfaces using React.js, while ensuring accessibility and user experience best practices.

• Collaborating on the definition of frontend architecture, alongside Tech Leads and other technical experts.

• Integrating backend APIs and handling complex state management and user interactions effectively.

• Participating in the implementation of automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and continuous integration pipelines.

• Contributing ideas on technology choices, frameworks, and libraries, and playing an active role in code quality improvement.

• Working in an agile environment, and collaborating effectively with UX/UI designers, Product Owners, and backend developers.

• Getting involved in the Capco frontend chapter through workshops, code reviews, tech watch, tech talks, and more.

At Capco, our stack includes Next.js 15 and therefore React.js 19. Our backend developers use Java / Spring Boot, and in some client contexts, we also offer NestJS—perfect for fullstack developers!

We also welcome React Native developers when responsive web solutions no longer meet our clients' needs.

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS

• Professional Experience

o Minimum of 5 years of experience in frontend development on complex projects or applications with high user exposure.

o Proven track record working on React.js production projects, ideally in micro-frontend or modular application environments.

o Experience working in agile teams, integrated within multidisciplinary setups

• Technical skills

o Advanced expertise in Next.js / React.js and its ecosystem (Hooks, React Router, Redux/Zustand/Recoil, Context API, etc.).

o Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (or modern styling tools like Styled Components, Tailwind CSS, etc.).

o Good practices in state management, side effect handling, and component lifecycle management.

o Experience with frontend automated testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.

o Basic understanding of accessibility principles (a11y) and UX standards.

o Familiarity with build tools and CI pipelines (e.g., Webpack, Vite, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

o Knowledge of additional frameworks (Next.js, Vue.js, Angular) is a valuable asset.

• Soft Skills and Other Competencies

o Autonomous, detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and rigor.

o Strong team player, able to communicate and collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments (UX/UI, backend, Product Owners, QA...).

o Passion for building well-designed, high-performance interfaces, with a constant focus on the user experience.

o Keen on knowledge sharing and contributing to continuous improvement.

o Technologically curious, with a desire for ongoing growth and learning.

o Fluent in English.

***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

We also welcome React Native developers when responsive web solutions no longer meet our clients' needs.

* Professional Experience
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in frontend development on complex projects or applications with high user exposure.
* Proven track record working on React.js production projects, ideally in micro-frontend or modular application environments.
* Experience working in agile teams, integrated within multidisciplinary setups
* Technical skills
* Advanced expertise in Next.js / React.js and its ecosystem (Hooks, React Router, Redux/Zustand/Recoil, Context API, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (or modern styling tools like Styled Components, Tailwind CSS, etc.).
* Good practices in state management, side effect handling, and component lifecycle management.
* Experience with frontend automated testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
* Basic understanding of accessibility principles (a11y) and UX standards.
* Familiarity with build tools and CI pipelines (e.g., Webpack, Vite, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
* Knowledge of additional frameworks (Next.js, Vue.js, Angular) is a valuable asset.

* Autonomous, detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and rigor.

* Passion for building well-designed, high-performance interfaces, with a constant focus on the user experience.
* Keen on knowledge sharing and contributing to continuous improvement.
* Technologically curious, with a desire for ongoing growth and learning.
* Fluent in English.

* Develop platform integrations using MuleSoft and AWS services as appropriate.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve reliability, security, and maintainability.

* Support Agentforce and Prompt Builder capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve field-service efficiency through AI and automation.
* Contribute to platform modernization and engineering excellence.

**Qualifications:**

**Required Experience:**

* 4-6 years of progressive software engineering experience.
* Experience developing enterprise Salesforce solutions.
* Strong experience with Lightning Web Components, Apex, and Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Salesforce Service Cloud
* Omni-Channel
* Lightning Web Components
* Apex Development
* Copado
* Agentforce.

* Prompt Builder
* Salesforce Field Service
* Salesforce Mobile App
* MuleSoft
* AWS Lambda, EC2, SQS, and Kinesis.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or equivalent.

**Note:**
This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune.

* At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.
* Headquartered in El Segundo, California, DIRECTV has been a household name in sports and entertainment for 30 years. We've grown our global footprint with DIRECTV India, a capability center in Pune built to support our operations and speed up how we build new technology. Here, our teams work on the platforms and products that bring together satellite and streaming, so customers get their favorite content without the hassle of switching between apps or inputs. From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that.

* Asynchronous & Streaming Protocols: Strong hands-on experience handling Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSocket’s, and resilient asynchronous API integration.

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description:
**Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXR**
VenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 - Technical + Managerial

**Baner, Pune.**
Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.
  
  
Skills: mcp,django,react.js,langgraph,system design,sql,orchestration,langchain,docker

title: Oracle Cloud Technical Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Technical - Senior Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations maximize value from enterprise technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As a Senior Consultant within Managed Services, you will support clients in sustaining, enhancing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions that drive operational performance and business continuity. Working as part of a team of experienced advisors and technical specialists, you will help deliver scalable solutions, solve complex operational challenges, and support ongoing transformation through technology, process improvement, and managed services delivery.
  
  
**Level**
: Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant, Managed Services on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing, developing, and supporting Oracle Cloud technical solutions across managed services engagements
* Building and maintaining reports, interfaces, extensions, and data conversion components using SQL, BI Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, Financial Reporting Studio, and File-Based Data Import templates
* Developing and supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, Service-Oriented Architecture, Representational State Transfer services, Simple Object Access Protocol services, and Web Services Description Language-based services
* Performing production support activities, including issue analysis, queue monitoring, ticket updates, code migration support, and resolution within service-level requirements
* Collaborating with functional, technical, onsite, and offshore teams to support testing, deployments, enhancements, and ongoing platform stability

**The team**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
  
  
The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6-10 years of experience in Oracle Cloud technical implementation, enhancement, or managed services support
* Experience developing conversions, interfaces, reports, and extensions using SQL, BI Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, Financial Reporting Studio, and File-Based Data Import templates
* Experience supporting 4-5 Oracle Cloud modules, including navigation, data tables, and end-to-end process flows
* Experience developing or supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, Service-Oriented Architecture, Representational State Transfer services, Simple Object Access Protocol services, and Web Services Description Language
* Experience with BI Publisher reports, Enterprise Scheduler Service jobs, data conversions, and production support activities
* Experience with information technology service management processes, including incident, problem, and enhancement management, stakeholder updates, and service-level agreement-based support
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or business

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience delivering 2-3 integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud or Service-Oriented Architecture
* Experience applying cloud integration patterns in Oracle Cloud environments
* Experience with business intelligence security roles
* Experience with code migration, code reviews, naming standards, and technical quality practices
* Experience with performance tuning and SQL optimization
* Experience supporting global delivery teams across onsite and offshore models

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

title: Senior UI Engineer
description:
**About SailPoint & The Team**

SailPoint is the enterprise leader in identity security. Our engineering team delivers scalable, cloud-native SaaS products hosted on modern, event-driven microservice architectures in AWS.

We are seeking a versatile
**UI Developer**
who is enthusiastic about user experience and eager to solve real-world enterprise workflow challenges. In this role, you will be an integral part of an Agile engineering team, modernizing existing web interfaces, building responsive frontend features, and collaborating closely with UX designers and backend engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Frontend Architecture:**
  Design and build intuitive, maintainable, responsive web application UIs utilizing JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.
* **Component Modernization:**
  Evolve enterprise UI modules from legacy ExtJS structures to responsive AngularJS and modern frontend standards.
* **Full-Stack Collaboration:**
  Consume and make targeted enhancements to supporting backend REST APIs built on Java and Groovy.
* **Prototyping & UX:**
  Partner closely with UX consultants and product managers to rapidly prototype interaction designs and incorporate user feedback.
* **Telemetry & Quality:**
  Instrument and monitor frontend performance telemetry to pinpoint user friction points; develop automated test suites across modern desktop and mobile browsers.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of professional software development experience building cross-browser compatible, responsive web applications.
* **Core Web Stack:**
  Strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript (ES5/ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, JSON, REST APIs, AJAX, and HTTP lifecycle.
* **Framework Experience:**
  Practical experience with JavaScript frameworks and build tools such as AngularJS, ExtJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, Grunt, or Bower.
* **Testing Automation:**
  Proven experience with automated UI testing frameworks (e.g., Karma, Jasmine, Protractor, Selenium).
* **Backend Fundamentals:**
  Working familiarity with Java or server-side scripting concepts to support full-stack collaboration.
* **Collaboration & Communication:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills with an appetite for learning and working in an Agile/Scrum team.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Java web servers and application frameworks (Apache Tomcat, Spring, Grails, Groovy, servlets).
* Exposure to cloud deployments on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience with mobile web viewports and responsive layouts (Cordova/PhoneGap, iOS/Android web views).
* Familiarity with commercial enterprise security or identity management products.

**What You Will Achieve (Year 1 Milestones)**

* **First 30 Days (Ramp Up & Defect Resolution):**
  Master local development tooling (Grunt, Bower, npm), map legacy ExtJS and AngularJS dependencies, and resolve at least 5 initial frontend bug fixes across supported web browsers.
* **First 60 Days (Migrate Components & Prototype UX):**
  Convert initial legacy ExtJS views into clean AngularJS components, collaborate on interaction wireframes, and make targeted updates to supporting Java/Groovy backend REST APIs.
* **First 90 Days (Automated Testing & Telemetry):**
  Build automated cross-browser test suites (Karma, Jasmine, Protractor), achieving >80% test coverage on newly delivered UI components with zero visual regressions across mobile and desktop viewports.
* **Months 4–12 (Full Feature Ownership):**
  Independently take user stories from wireframe design to production-ready releases, delivering predictable sprint estimates and continuously improving application performance.

**About SailPoint India & Employee Benefits (Pune Location)**

* **Comprehensive Health & Wellness:**
  100% company-paid medical insurance premiums covering employees and eligible dependents; includes accidental and term life coverage.
* **Preventive Care:**
  Annual company-sponsored health check-ups for employees and discounted diagnostic rates for family members.
* **Financial & Equity Rewards:**
  Competitive base salary, annual performance bonus, and eligibility for equity incentives.
* **Generous Paid Time Off:**
  24 paid annual leaves plus 10 declared public holidays each year.
* **Workplace Flexibility:**
  Hybrid work model (2–3 days in-office per week) with flexible working hours for sustainable work-life balance.
* **Modern Workspace & Community:**
  Cutting-edge Pune office campus with ergonomic workstations, fully stocked pantry snacks, and regular team celebrations.

title: Application Engineering, Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who gets energized by the moment when a piece of software you built actually clicks for the person using it. Not when it compiles without errors, but when an engineer on the other side of the world opens your application and their workflow just got easier. You have learned that the hardest part of building useful tools is not the technical implementation, it is understanding what people are actually trying to accomplish.
   

  

 You think in systems, but you communicate in plain language. When a customer describes a problem, you can hold the technical architecture in your head while also tracking what they really need versus what they think they need. You ask clarifying questions that get to the root without making people feel interrogated.
   

  

 You do not wait for perfect information before you start building. You sketch out a solution, validate the approach with the people who will use it, and iterate based on what you learn. When something does not work the way you expected, you dig into why instead of just trying a different approach and hoping it sticks.
   

  

 You care about craft. You write code that someone else can pick up six months from now and understand. You document not because someone told you to, but because you know that good documentation is a gift to your future self and everyone who comes after you.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will find a place where the applications you build get used by engineers solving real problems.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Design and build full stack web applications using Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS that integrate simulation technologies into customer engineering workflows
* Develop backend services and RESTful APIs that connect frontend interfaces to Python\-based automation engines, including PyAnsys libraries where applicable
* Work directly with customers and internal Synopsys teams to translate engineering requirements into working web solutions that fit their actual use cases
* Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate code generation, improve UI/UX prototyping, debug more effectively, and increase test coverage
* Contribute to code reviews, write clear documentation, and help maintain code quality standards across development projects
* Participate in technical demos and customer presentations to show case solutions, gather feedback, and support adoption of new capabilities


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* You will deliver web applications that make complex simulation workflows accessible and usable for engineers who depend on them to meet project deadlines
* Your backend services and APIs will enable automation that saves customers hours of manual configuration and data handling per project cycle
* The solutions you build will directly influence how customers adopt and scale simulation\-driven design processes across their engineering teams
* Your collaboration with product teams will surface real\-world usage patterns that shape roadmap priorities and improve tool usability based on actual customer needs
* Your containerized deployments and CI/CD pipelines will reduce release cycles and improve reliability for customer\-facing solutions
* You will bridge the gap between advanced simulation technology and practical engineering workflows, making powerful capabilities accessible to users who are not simulation experts
* Your contributions to code quality and documentation will raise development standards for the team and accelerate onboarding for future engineers


 What You'll Need
   

  

* You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with 2\+ years of professional software development experience, or a Master's degree with relevant project or internship experience
* You bring strong proficiency in Python for backend development, including hands\-on experience with Python\-based web or UI frameworks
* You have working knowledge of frontend development concepts and UI/UX principles, with the ability to translate user needs into functional interfaces that people actually want to use
* You are comfortable using Git for version control in a collaborative team environment where multiple people are working in the same codebase
* You have a solid understanding of core backend and infrastructure concepts, including RESTful API design, network fundamentals, and database systems, enabling you to effectively contribute to robust, full\-stack application development.
* You communicate clearly in written and spoken English and can explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders without losing the important details
* Experience with the Ansys software ecosystem ,PyAnsys, or similar scientific and engineering application domains is a plus, as is familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can sit with a customer or internal stakeholder, listen to what they are trying to accomplish, and walk away with enough clarity to start building without needing every detail spelled out in advance
* When you review code or see a UI that does not quite work, you speak up with specific suggestions instead of just noting that something feels off, and you do it in a way that helps the team move forward
* You manage multiple threads at once without dropping details, a bug fix, a new feature request, and a deployment can all be in flight and you know exactly where each one stands
* You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adjusting your communication style so that nothing gets lost in translation and everyone stays aligned
* You test your own work thoroughly before handing it off because you know that catching issues early saves everyone time downstream and builds trust with the people depending on your code
* You are genuinely curious about how simulation and engineering tools get used in the real world, and that curiosity makes you ask better questions and build better solutions


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Ansys Customer Excellence team, working at the intersection of engineering simulation, modern software platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions. This is a technical role where you will collaborate with customers, internal product teams, and engineers across geographies to shape how simulation technologies are integrated into scalable, cloud\-native platforms. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current initiatives, and collaboration model during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 At
 **Infotech.Works** 
 , we partner with startups and innovators to turn raw ideas into working products—fast. Our projects typically move from idea to deployment in
 **2–6 months** 
 , starting with rapid discovery and moving quickly into execution.
 



 We’re looking for a
 **Technical Lead** 
 who combines
 **deep engineering fundamentals** 
 with
 **AI\-powered speed** 
 —someone who can design solid systems, make the right architectural trade\-offs, and still ship fast.
 



 This role is for someone who can
 **think deeply and execute quickly**

**What You’ll Do**



* Translate business ideas into
 **robust technical architectures and system designs**

* Data models

* Performance trade\-offs

 **standardized architecture approaches**

**Core Requirement: Strong Engineering Fundamentals (Critical)**




 We are
